speaker: (the carter)
text: Mind the ruts, master. She pulls left when the kennel is wet, and October is wet enough without being November.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will mind them. I am going home to a dinner, not into your wheel.

speaker: (the carter)
text: Then go home. The gate is the same both ways, and I am not a guide.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the gate. Good day to your horse.
